p0.title: Embedded analyzer/final result verifiers accept incomplete synthetic PASS trees
evidence: the exact embedded analyzer-tree verifier accepted a result containing only minimal schema/status/design/conservation/ablation/claim fields, arbitrary CSV and RUN_COMPLETE=FAIL_NOT_COMPLETE
the exact embedded final-tree verifier accepted a terminal receipt with no schema or identity and an empty output_members_preseal map
result row, conservation and claim exact key sets, CSV-to-JSON equality, completion token and terminal identity are not checked
p0.impact: A wrong runtime output can pass both pre-publish and post-publish verification and become a sealed canonical PASS tree.

p0.title: Failures after result publication never quarantine the canonical result
evidence: cleanup moves attempt and staging coordinates but has no RESULT_DIR-to-quarantine rename
post-publish rehash, attempt-seal or consume failure leaves the canonical result in place
a signal after attempt consume and before SUCCESS=1 leaves both result and consumed attempt because the cleanup trigger sees no attempt or staging
p0.impact: A failed runner invocation can leave a result tree that is indistinguishable from canonical success.

p1.title: Post-publish and post-consume terminal rehash omits authorization and consumed-attempt closure
evidence: post_publish_canonical_rehash does not compare AUTH_SHA_START or call verify_future_authorization
the newly sealed attempt is not verified before consume and the consumed canonical is not rehashed after rename
no final all-coordinate terminal predicate runs immediately before SUCCESS=1

p1.title: The analyzer-to-runner-staging publication still uses exists plus replacing os.rename
evidence: M597 publish_result uses Path.exists for output and internal staging coordinates
the internal staging is published to runner STAGING_DIR with os.rename rather than renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE
the runner's earlier coordinate check does not close the check-to-rename entry-injection window

p2.title: Frozen sealed-directory verification permits extra unmanifested members
p2.evidence: verify_sealed_dir validates every listed member but never compares the manifest member set with the directory's actual regular-file set.

authorization.only_allowed_next_step: author a new immutable repaired runner identity and request another fresh independent static hammer
